description: The Baude main window's keyboard shortcuts and zoom. Shortcuts work from anywhere in the window unless noted; on a Mac Ctrl is replaced by ⌘ where stated (Settings, Feedback, zoom, find, command palette), and the Alt arrows become ⌥⌘.

parts.name: sessions and panel
parts.shows: Showing and hiding the window's panes.

actions.does: Shows the sessions sidebar and focuses its search
Meta shown and focused in the side panel, or closed if already shown there

actions.by: key F2 (on a focused sidebar row)

actions.does: Send Feedback, over whatever is open
Opens a command palette of every name in the glossary, searched
Find in the chat the focus is in (see FindBar); in the Kubernetes view its filter; in a code tab its find

parts.name: tabs
parts.shows: The main area has the chat pinned first and a tab for each code file opened from the chat; the tab bar shows only while code is open.

actions.does: Closes the current code tab (the chat tab stays)
Back and forward through the tabs, as a browser's history
Up one level from the current page

parts.name: chat zoom
parts.shows: The chat's text and the composer's text scale together (the chat column only: not the header, sidebar or side panel). Range 60 % to 250 % in steps of 0.1; the size is remembered between runs. Ctrl+0 returns to the default size (1.0 unless Settings → default zoom says otherwise). The place being read is kept while the text re-flows: only what is near the view is laid out at once and the rest comes back a few messages a frame, nearest first.

phone.why: The key and Ctrl+scroll triggers are hardware-input shortcuts; the setting itself (chat text size 0.6 to 2.5) is not desktop-only, and a phone gets it by pinch or in Settings

actions.by: key Ctrl + (also Ctrl+= , Ctrl+Shift+=, keypad +; ⌘ on a Mac)
key Ctrl - (also Ctrl+_, keypad -; ⌘ on a Mac)

actions.does: Zoom in/out: a wheel click is a step; touchpad deltas add up to steps. Over a code page or the database diagram the key and scroll zoom that view's own size instead

parts.name: zoom toast
parts.shows: A short toast at the bottom of the window, one second, "Chat zoom 1.4" (the factor written with trailing zeros dropped: 1.0, 1.2, 1.25). A burst of presses shares one toast and updates its text.

parts.name: full width
parts.shows: ☰ → Full-width text: limits the chat column to 860 px wide when off (centred) and lets it fill the window when on. No key. On from a fresh installation.

parts.name: window
parts.shows: A normal resizable window, 900 by 800 px at first, titled "Baude" or "Baude — <chat name>". Its size, whether maximised and where it was (on a Mac, which display) come back after ☰ → Restart Baude, with the sidebar and side panel states and the width the side panel was dragged to. Closing it stops the chat's own claude (a host's chat goes on there).

phone.why: Window size, position, maximise and close are desktop window management

parts.name: panes' rules
parts.shows: The sessions sidebar and the side panel are split from the chat by a 1 px rule that is dragged to resize; the side panel never covers the chat below its minimum (320 px panel). Dropping files on the window attaches them (see Composer).

phone.why: Drag-to-resize splitters and drag-and-drop between windows
